research_rationale:
Executive Order 11851 of April 10, 1975 (40 FR 16645) delegates to the Secretary of the Treasury, with the concurrence of the Secretary of State and the Special Representative for Trade Negotiations, authority to issue regulations preventing importation of certain European Community cheeses on which export restitution payments were made, to implement a December 1974 agreement, and lets agency heads redelegate (section 2). It rests on section 204 of the Agricultural Act of 1956, 7 U.S.C. 1854, and 3 U.S.C. 301, neither of which the order or any held source shows to have been repealed; the Code section 7 U.S.C. 1854 is itself current (its text is held in the repository at jobs/theophilus-sources/output/texts/usc-t7-s1854.txt, which is not a registered packet source and is mentioned only as context). The held original (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11851.txt, an official Federal Register OCR text with irregular letter spacing) has no own-terms end, expiry, deadline or condition. The order has no later amending or revoking instrument: the Federal Register disposition catalog search found none, the lookup of held texts citing the number found only the 1989 OFR codification entry and a 19 CFR 12.6 text that cites the order as the source of the restitution-payment affidavit, and the U.S. Code note under 7 U.S.C. 1854 reproduces the order (current release point 119-121, through 2026-10-09) with the bracketed editorial update "[now United States Trade Representative]", showing it is still printed as in force. The eCFR search recorded two hits including 19 CFR 12.6 (held at jobs/theophilus-sources/output/texts/cfr-t19-12.6.txt, not a registered packet source), whose text still requires affidavits that cheese has not received "restitution payments of the type referred to in Executive Order No. 11851"; it is context for the continuing predicate, not the cited basis.
